## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands and results. For gameplay/rendering changes, include headset,
runtime/connection, game edition/build, character class and scenario. State
which checks or headset scenarios have not been run.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/bearstonem/d2r-pcvr/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This PR targets `main` and comes from my fork, or I am a maintainer using a repository branch.
- [ ] The change is focused, with relevant documentation and regression coverage where needed.
- [ ] I accurately described validation and any remaining limitations above.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the project license and preserved required credits.
- [ ] I included no game assets, extracted caches, memory dumps, saves, build output or secrets.
- [ ] Any game testing used offline characters only; otherwise, no game testing was performed.
